summary: Office Measurement Worksheet UI parity increment verified end-to-end against the live app (https://field-office-sync-2.preview.emergentagent.com) as Owner. All 10 review-request criteria PASS. Section order Structures → Roof planes → Roof lines → Penetrations → Existing Roof & Deck → Ventilation → Access / Conditions → Gutters (Optional) → measurement photos is exactly as required, and Ventilation / Access are SEPARATE cards from Existing Roof & Deck (three distinct data-testid'd cards). No user-facing 'Facet' text anywhere in the worksheet innerText; tot-facets tile labels 'ROOF PLANES'; PitchSelect lists 2/12–12/12 + 'Custom…' and persists both 6/12 (canonical 6) and Custom 7.5 across a full reload (pitch-custom input reopens with 7.5). Add/Remove for Structure/Roof plane/Roof line saves cleanly, backend reflects post-remove counts (1/1/0) with no dangling refs. Roof line ft=42 in=6 renders '42.5 LF' live; after save+reload edges[0].length_ft=42.5 with primary+secondary facet_id, label='Front eave', notes='Line notes' all persisted. Section round-trip persisted for Deck Type='OSB-XYZ', Damaged Deck SF=50, Full Re-deck=true, Ridge Vent LF=77, Steep Access=true, Conditions notes='Access-notes-1', Gutter LF=150, Gutter Notes='gutter-notes-abc'. NO 'Reported area SF' input and NO 'Reported report area' comparison line exist in the worksheet. Save button reads exactly 'Save Measurements' and status stays 'Draft' after a normal save (never advances to Field Complete). Hidden-metadata safety verified via API GET after a normal Office save on a seeded revision (provider='eagleview', report_id='EV-TEST-1', reported_area_sqft=2500, F1 orientation_azimuth=180, F1 geometry={poly:[[0,0],[10,0],[10,10]]}, and hidden summary tearoff_notes='hidden-tearoff' / decking_notes='hidden-deck') — ALL preserved unchanged after the UI save. Conflict regression re-verified quickly: behind-back server advance → UI Save → 409 → 'Needs Review' banner shown, Save disabled, 'Use Latest Version' clears banner and adopts server values (Area SF input=1200); a second behind-back advance + 'Keep My Version' + confirm succeeds with 'Your version saved over the newer copy' toast and API GET confirms Office won (facet.area_sqft=1275) while server-hidden metadata was preserved (reported_area_sqft=5555 from the newer server copy, F1 orientation_azimuth=180 intact).
critical_code_review_comments: MeasurementWorksheet.jsx cleanly separates Existing Roof & Deck / Ventilation / Access into three distinct testid'd cards with a collapsible Gutters section following. Ordering, labels, placeholders, and Save wording all match the spec.

PitchSelect correctly toggles between the 2–12 canonical list (+ Custom…) and a numeric rise input; canonical vs custom detection uses PITCHES.includes(Number(value)) which correctly persists 6 as '6/12' and 7.5 as a custom rise on reopen.

buildEditablePayload preserves top-level hidden metadata (source/provider/report_id/notes) from `base` (the loaded revision) and forces reported_area_sqft to come from the loaded revision via toEditable — a stale form can no longer erase it on a normal Office save. Verified end-to-end via API GET.

buildRebasePayload continues to preserve server hidden facet fields (orientation_azimuth, geometry) matched by stable id/ref and merges summary keys with server-first + editable-only override — verified via the two-step conflict test.
seed_data_creation: Created a fresh lead 'UI Parity Lead 1788354107' (id f6c7bbb4-... via /api/mobile/leads) and a seeded measurement 0ad656d9-b09f-4ad8-8d0b-258b301f98af with provider='eagleview', report_id='EV-TEST-1', reported_area_sqft=2500, one facet F1 (pitch 6, area 1200, orientation_azimuth=180, geometry poly triangle), and hidden summary keys tearoff_notes/decking_notes. Test data is non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Office worksheet UI parity is fully green. For future 'behind-back' PUTs to force a 409, keep mapping structures[].id→ref, facets[].id→ref (preserving structure_id→structure_ref, orientation_azimuth, geometry) — do NOT PUT raw GET output. If filling section-summary inputs programmatically in JS, prefer Playwright's locator.fill() over synthesized React input events (the latter can silently no-op on React 18 controlled inputs).
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. All parity requirements met; data-safety regressions (Needs Review / Use Latest / Keep My Version / hidden-metadata preservation) remain intact.
